== PC Discord and Retro Club facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Added the extra game between Timo Dusel and Geoff Bowman (Solidsnack3 in #retro-league-pc, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (17 August 2024), [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/1190452472477655170/1274342366068609035 Discord message]).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The Discord announcement of 17 August 2024 says six weeks of play "were not enough to decide a winner" and calls the Dusel–Bowman game "a postseason game to help decide a winner". The final standings posted on 18 August 2024 put [[Paul Todd Feldman]] first, Bowman second and Dusel third ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1428053#p1428053 final standings post]). The week 6 pairings post says tables 1–3 held the undefeated players: Brad Kippel v Paul Todd Feldman, Thomas Nguyen v Timo Dusel, Matthew Ford v Geoff Bowman ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1427555#p1427555 Leverandon, 7 August 2024]; Preserved copy of the thread: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012163023/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84005.html Internet Archive]). The article keeps the posted standings and adds only that the two players, both undefeated in the Swiss games, played a streamed extra game. Whether that game decided the event winner or only second and third place needs a source.
